technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions present but overwhelmed by bearish structure, negative volume signals, and absence of bullish confirmation—high risk of continued downside despite potential bounce.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (22/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 purchase vs 2 sales, all small amounts) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (373.76) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 63 days presents moderate event risk for industrials sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold conditions (9 and 14) combined with fear-zone sentiment (22/100) and ADX trending signal create a contrarian bounce opportunity near support at 105.78.
debate.key_bear_argument: Bearish structure dominates with price below all moving averages, negative volume (CMF, OBV), three black crows pattern, VIX crisis regime (373.76), and zero fundamental catalysts—oversold bounce risk is high but downside continuation risk is higher.
